name: People
overview: Scripture reveals the profound value God places on people, describing them as more precious than fine gold, emphasizing their worth and significance. Yet, following Christ may bring division and challenges, as He declares His mission will not bring peace but a sword, highlighting the cost of discipleship. Ultimately, God's love for the world is demonstrated in the giving of His only Son, offering eternal life to all who believe, underscoring the central hope and salvation available to every person.
